summary: Creates a straight line between explicit Point A and Point B endpoints, with configurable point count and optional texture coordinates.

key_params.name: points
key_params.note: Number of points along the line.

common_gotchas: The official Line SOP page does not define `dist` or `direction`; use `pa` and `pb` endpoints.
A two-point line has no interior samples for smooth curve-like deformation.
Line geometry often needs a render path such as Wire MAT, Line MAT, or conversion/thickening for visible surfaces.
key_concepts: Line SOP creates straight lines between Point A and Point B.
Endpoint vectors `pa` and `pb` define the line in 3D space.
`points` controls the number of points along the line and must be at least two for an actual segment.
`texture` applies unit texture coordinates along the generated line.
